findings.description: _docToNewsItem() used Firestore doc ID as disclosureIndex fallback when disclosure_id was null/empty. Since Firestore can store the same KAP disclosure under multiple doc IDs, each copy got a unique disclosureIndex = docId, making KapNewsService.dedupe() see them as distinct items.
findings.fix: Removed docId parameter entirely. disclosureIndex is now null when disclosure_id is absent, letting _buildDeduplicationKey() fall through to the URL-based key (detail_url) which is the true unique identifier per KAP disclosure.
